items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: It was Benny Kruger. Benny Kruger. One of the most versatile men in New York at the time.

ctx.x: Now I'll tell you the names of the men. Robertson joined us as piano player which he had been the first steady piano player after Regis' death. We had Shields, myself, Spobara, Edwards and what's his name? Roberts had made the five of us.
And that's immediately upon coming back from London. That's right. Robertson Hilton. And then what was the name of the saxophone players? I want to get that to you.
It was Benny Kruger. Benny Kruger. One of the most versatile men in New York at the time. Yes sir. But he was not a jazz man.
